title: Requirement Atomizer functional truth-set entry (gold_functional_v1)
description: One expert-annotated functional requirement. Field model is isomorphic to functional_catalog (objective/behaviors/preconditions/data_constraints/variants/exceptions/related_dlms_objects) plus a source_anchor structure (section + coordinate list + optional conflict_with cross-reference). Used by tools/agreement.py (inter-annotator agreement) and tools/functional_truth_eval.py (direct-extract recall/precision).

entry_id.description: Stable annotator-local id, unique within one expert's file.

doc_ref.description: Document identifier. Recall/precision are reported per doc_ref and never averaged across documents.

annotation_status.description: real = genuine expert annotation; fixture = synthetic self-proof entry. Defaults to real when absent. Tools count only real entries toward truth_status; fixtures are reported separately and never masquerade as annotations.

objective.description: One independently testable system-behavior goal. Verbatim transcribed from / tightly anchored to the source clause.

data_constraints.description: Numeric/unit/OBIS values transcribed verbatim. Scored by exact set equality (no unit conversion, no rounding) — see agreement.py.

source_anchor.description: Source provenance anchor. Entry-level matching (agreement + recall/precision) requires same section AND >=1 shared coordinate.

section.description: Clause/section label, e.g. '4.1.2'. Must match the parser's source_section coordinate space (block ids share this granularity).

coordinates.description: Anchor coordinates in the parser's coordinate space (block ids, e.g. BLK-000123). Granularity (paragraph vs sentence) MUST be frozen in the annotation spec before D3 agreement runs.

conflict_with.description: Optional cross-reference to the entry_id of a conflicting peer ('mark do not resolve' convention). Entries carrying conflict_with are exempt from entry-agreement Dice (both files); the referenced peer must exist in the same file or the entry fails protocol compliance.

expects_drilldown.description: Optional calibration hint: this entry warrants atom-level evidence (multi-behavior / multi-condition). When present, tools/functional_truth_eval.py --sweep-thresholds uses it as the drill-decision ground truth; when absent the sweep falls back to a deterministic richness proxy. Populate during S2 annotation only when the entry genuinely needs drilling.
